maker: Moïse Pernod (Perrenod, Pérrenoud), Aux Ponts de Martel (near Neuchâtel), Switzerland
location: Neuchâtel, Musée d’Art et d’Histoire, AA3830.
provenance: Acquired by the museum from the family of H. Vuille. Flat bell-stay, church-tower pattern; etched.
remarks: Richly decorated, with shell pattern on garland. Acanthus pattern on rim wire. 50mm piece near mouthpiece may have been intended for tuning. Restored by Cristian Bosc, 2013.
